defect_verification.selection_tie_note: Every one of the 6 new rows sits at a DOMINANCE TIE at z-hat: the alternative corner of the same owner edge has dominance margin 0 to within 1e-61 and is equally valid as a selection. The two tied corners give DIFFERENT theta-gradients (e.g. +1/2 vs -1/2 for the (0,1) rows), so this is theory.md G5 biting at the jam itself, not only along routes. The cone results below are unaffected (the possibly-active menu contains both, and cone(conv) = cone), but any (C) continuation certificate must carry both selections at its faces.

Certified by a strict Farkas witness: all 42 products grad g_k . y are verified > 0 in mpmath.iv at dps 60, min = 0.221300 (v1: 0.229700). This also re-certifies cone pointedness and boundedness of the multiplier polytope on v2, and keeps the FJ lambda_0 = 0 branch EMPTY at z-hat.
nonneg_self_stress.method: [IV] Gordan pair: the LP for a nonnegative self-stress is infeasible AND a rational strict Farkas direction is verified in mpmath.iv. FULLY RIGOROUS.

correction_block.note: rank(A2 over the 40 load-bearing rows) = 33 < 34, so no square retained subsystem avoids the two forced-zero rows. The correction uses a [RFP]-certified 33x33 block and the FULL 34-equation residual is verified in mpmath.iv below.

task2.headline: The UNIFORM floor over all 42 rows is 0: rows [0, 2] (['W0c0[x=0]', 'W0c1[y=0]']) are FORCED to lambda = 0 by the v2 stationarity system (their max over the whole multiplier polytope is 0). Excluding exactly those two rows, the floor is 0.047644047 -- i.e. theory.md's constant 0.047644 SURVIVES the basis repair verbatim; only its STATEMENT needs the restriction. Sum of lambda* grows 4.353502 -> 4.518763.
task2.impact_on_theory_A: theory.md (A)/Consequence 1 reads s(z) >= Phi(z) + lambda_floor * G(z) with G = sum over ALL rows. On v2 that form is FALSE as written (lambda_floor = 0). The repaired form is G(z) = sum over the 40 non-forced-zero rows, with the SAME constant 0.047644. The only escapes with no first-order ascent guarantee are those that open ONLY rows [0, 2] -- and those break sets are covered by the kill-test cascade in Task 4 (see synthesis).
task2.method: [EXACT+IV] per-row min/max over P by 84 LPs; Chebyshev LP for the restricted floor; the 8 rows outside a [RFP]-certified invertible 34-subsystem frozen at rationalised LP values and the 34 remaining re-solved at mpmath dps 90, rationalised at denominator 1e45; residual bounded in mpmath.iv dps 60.

task3.alive_breaksets_note: the full list of 70499 alive break sets is not stored (it would dominate the file); it is fully determined by the 72 maximal ones, since aliveness is downward closed.
task3.method: [LP, exhaustive over all 2^42 break sets] B is cone-alive iff the LP {lambda >= 0, A^T lambda = e_s, lambda_B = 0} is feasible. Aliveness is downward closed, so a breadth-first sweep that only extends alive sets by rows of Z0 = {k : min_P lambda_k = 0} enumerates the ENTIRE alive family; every other break set is cone-dead. 122339 LPs. Min support = 42 - (largest alive set).
task3.cross_check_method: [IV] rational Farkas y with y[33] = -1 and every grad g_m . y > 0 verified in mpmath.iv dps 60, for 20 random cone-dead sets of size K+1 = 14. Certifies e_s not in cone{grad g_m} rigorously.

task5.structural_verdict: ZERO existing M2 certificates transfer, and the reason is structural, not clerical: rank(A over the unchanged rows 0..35) = 32, not 34. The two v1 dist rows contributed exactly the 2 missing dimensions, so EVERY M2 (E) certificate's 34-row square subsystem must use row 36 or 37, and every (W) certificate's self-stress omega lives in the v1 4-dimensional self-stress space, which is not a subspace of v2's 8-dimensional one. Counts: 0 of 143 (E) certs and 0 of 81 (W) certs even avoid the dropped rows syntactically.
task5.m2_delta_queue_note: the delta queue is the whole union work queue of Task 4 (25050 break sets, stored there); nothing is inherited.
task5.transfer_criterion: A v1 M2 certificate applies VERBATIM to a v2 break set B2 iff every v1 row it uses -- basis_rows for an (E) certificate, basis_rows plus the support of omega for a (W) certificate -- lies in the unchanged block 0..35 (so it never touches the dropped dist rows 36, 37) and is MAINTAINED under B2 (no intersection with B2). For a (W) certificate the original break set must also be contained in B2, since the argument bounds sum_B omega_b g_b from below on Sbar(B).
task5.caveat: This is a SYNTACTIC transfer test, and it is conservative in one direction only: a certificate that passes it is genuinely valid on v2, but a certificate that fails it may still be repairable cheaply (e.g. re-deriving omega on the v2 self-stress space, which is now 8- dimensional instead of 4). The uncovered list is therefore an upper bound on M2's delta queue.
